meta.source: Brand board and phone mock supplied by the owner (2026-10-31); app chrome values from index.html on main 065f413; logo traced to SVG from the board (docs/brand/make_logo.py)

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything. Board value for dark; light is the board's Text Primary turned ground (monochrome dark-on-light panel).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Header bar, buttons, chips, sheets: one step up from background.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Wordmark, chord progression line, body copy on background and surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Tagline (CHORDS & PROGRESSIONS), captions, chip labels on background and surface.

tokens.name: accent-teal
tokens.usage: Logo orbit start and its glow; subtle accents only (focus ring, active underline). Never body text.

tokens.name: accent-gold
tokens.usage: Logo orbit end and its glow; subtle accents only. Never body text.

tokens.name: warm-white
tokens.usage: Logo line-art (the pan) in full colour; hairline strokes of the mark.

tokens.name: mark-single
tokens.usage: Single-colour mark, lockup wordmark and app icon on background or surface (dark grounds only).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px borders of buttons, chips and the header bar on background and surface.

tokens.name: mark-ground
tokens.usage: Dark tile behind the full-colour mark in both themes (cover, app icons, light pages): the glow is never placed on a light ground.

tokens.name: card-paper
tokens.usage: Chord card face (app --paper). Unchanged by the rebrand; same in both themes.

tokens.name: card-ink
tokens.usage: Diagram line-work and card header text on card-paper (app --ink).

tokens.name: legacy-table
tokens.usage: Current app ground (--table, theme-color). Reference for the migration: background replaces it.

tokens.name: legacy-table-2
tokens.usage: Current app radial highlight (--table2). Reference for the migration.

tokens.name: scale-kurd-root
tokens.usage: D Kurd 10 root colour: card frame, root fields, chip dot. Locked by CLAUDE.md.

tokens.name: scale-kurd-tone
tokens.usage: D Kurd 10 tone colour. Locked.

tokens.name: scale-amara10-root
tokens.usage: D Amara 10 root colour. Locked.

tokens.name: scale-amara10-tone
tokens.usage: D Amara 10 tone colour. Locked.

tokens.name: scale-amara-root
tokens.usage: D Amara 9 root colour. Locked.

tokens.name: scale-amara-tone
tokens.usage: D Amara 9 tone colour. Locked.

tokens.name: scale-hijaz-root
tokens.usage: C# Hijaz root colour. Locked.

tokens.name: scale-hijaz-tone
tokens.usage: C# Hijaz tone colour. Locked.

tokens.name: scale-pygmy-root
tokens.usage: F3 Low Pygmy root colour. Locked.

tokens.name: scale-pygmy-tone
tokens.usage: F3 Low Pygmy tone colour. Locked.

tokens.name: bottom-orange
tokens.usage: Bottom-shell U-labels and N BOTTOM NOTES badge, app and print. One orange only. Locked.

tokens.name: sp-1
tokens.usage: Inside a group: a label to the control it names (app ramp, phone).

tokens.name: sp-2
tokens.usage: Between peers in one group: chips, header buttons.

tokens.name: sp-3
tokens.usage: Between groups: header rows, chip row to card.

tokens.name: sp-4
tokens.usage: Around a surface; clear space around the logo lockup at minimum.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls and inputs (most common app radius).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Square icon buttons in the header (link, menu, prev, flip, next) and the chord card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Scale chips.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon squircle on the board (iOS-style mask).
